assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game UI sprite for a WWII Soviet Supreme Soviet council interface, asset hof_ic_leader_frame. Painted realistic Hearts of Iron style, subtle top-left light, crisp silhouette readable at 165x165 pixels. EMPTY central circular aperture must be truly alpha transparent, outside frame truly alpha transparent too, NO checkerboard drawn, no portrait, no text, no scene, no extra objects. Entire ornament inside square canvas with only 3 percent padding, ring has thin practical width leaving large portrait opening. Output transparent PNG, preferably 660x660 or square resolution. This is an individual usable sprite, not a mockup or asset sheet.
